purpose: Define every human-facing UI label as an explicit managed label identity with source text, context metadata and target-language translations, without changing canonical machine identities.

topics.name: Canonical UI Label
topics.purpose: Define every human-facing UI label as an explicit managed label identity with source text, context metadata and target-language translations, without changing canonical machine identities.

semantics.label_rule: Each managed UI label has an explicit stable label identity.
semantics.source_rule: Source-language label text is explicit data.
semantics.context_rule: Label includes context metadata sufficient to disambiguate meaning where needed.
semantics.machine_rule: Canonical IDs, command names, namespace roots and internal identifiers are never translated.
semantics.reuse_rule: One label identity may be reused across compatible UI surfaces when meaning/context is identical.
semantics.split_rule: Same source text with different meaning/context uses distinct label identities.

invariants.rule: Localization changes human-facing labels and explanatory text only; canonical identities, commands and machine semantics remain language-independent.

hard_gates.condition: translated text used as canonical ID
same source text reused across incompatible contexts
label lacks context where ambiguity is machine-significant
UI label text becomes semantic authority

references.purpose: Labels belong to human-facing Expose surfaces.
